notes.title: [Greenlight] [Tank it!] Anti-war game on Steam Greenlight, *Coming 2016*
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Bernd Geiblinger is pleased to present its new game on greenlight[/b][/h1]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=756644267

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/Tankit!review600.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Tank it! is made to communicate a clear message: 
#WarKills[/b][/h1]

[b]Tank it! is a realistic and bloody war simulation game designed to show how brutal and dangerous war really is… that it is no good... that countless civilians are killed as collateral damage.[/b]

In Tank it! you command a drone to remotely control a heavy tank. You receive the mission to travel to remote villages, find and destroy the target military camps and eliminate all terrorists. But as in real life, there are many civilians in the villages, as well. The terrorists and civilians alike are at the player’s mercy. It is up to the player alone to decide how to handle this mission.

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/Tankit_Art_5.jpg[/img]

Bernd Geiblinger: "I for one do not enjoy playing brutal, bloody games, so for me it is painful to create death animations and blood. I did everything else before I did this kind of work - but I am doing it for the message. This is also why Tank it! will be available for a very low value - For me it is much more important to spread the message of the game than to earn a great deal of revenue."

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=756644267

[b]we Hope you like it, thank you :) [/b]

[h1][b]Please visit the greenlight page for more info. Thank you for all of your support.[/b][/h1]

BplusGames & OtakuMaker.com Studio

notes.title: [Update V1.1] Puzzle Box is Here! *Modes + Many Improvements* - [Weekend Sale] - 20% OFF Now!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Puzzle Box Update V 1.1 is Here! *Modes + Many Improvements* - Apr 29, 2016 & Weekend Sale - 20% OFF Now![/b][/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/448720
[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/puzzle_box_card_01_pixel_paint_pot.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Update - Changes since Early Access Version:[/b][/h1]
 
[b]- Reworked all Classic Levels for smoother gameplay[/b]
    > Blocks to close at the left side gave it a difficult start
    > Recalculated the number of possible Combo Coins
 
[b]- Added Sectors 6-10[/b]
    > Lot of Copycat and Classic levels including English titles
 
[b]- Added Option-Screen in Pause Screen[/b]
    > Adjust Music Volume
    > Adjust Sounf Effects Volume
    > Adjust Graphic FX for slow CPUs (depending on mode)
   
[b]- Reworked the whole Universe Level Hub[/b]
    > Added caption and Combo Coin stats to sectors
    > Added appearance of sectors when locked, unlocked, perfect
    > Optimized camera movemend and speed
    > Optimized Holo start position and flying speed
    > Reworked way to unlock sectors from Combo Coins to Clear-All-Levels
    > Added artworks design plattchen as Combo Coin achievements
    > Added sounds when unlocking Modes
 
[b]- Reworked Classic and Copycat Modes[/b]
    > Added some Backgrounds and Music
    > Added a visible cursor
    > Changed the Color Indicator cursor for better visibility
    > Optimized Cursor Speed
    > Cleared Bug which changed the order of used colors on Color Wheel
    > Added EASY MODE for adjusting the scrolling speed on player skills
   
[b]- Reworked Boom Mode[/b]
    > Changed Block Design for more depth
    > Added Number for tries left
    > Added New Music Track
   
[b]- Reworked Kubi Mode[/b]
    > Optimized the AI which creates the level
    > Added Pixel Bombs with full physics to destroy all environment
    > Added option for AI to add Pixel Bombs if a level seems to hard
    > Added option for AI to add Pixel Bombs if a level seems to caged
    > Cleared some collision bugs which led Shadow Men wrestle
    > Changed personality of Pixel Flies to let them explore the world more
    > Added some intelligence to Pixo so he finds his food
    > Added physics for Pixos Food so it is reachable after environment got blasted
    > Changed Controls for Super Jump
    > Added EASY MODE for instant Super Kubi
   
[b]- Added Run Mode for Classic Levels[/b]
    > Run and Jump with Marshmallow Boy Roy through the Pixel Environment and collect all Combo Coins
    > Added EASY MODE for reducing speed of the shadow roll
 
[b]- Added Claw Mode for Classic Levels[/b]
    > Avoid ZeLeLi and transport all Combo Coins to the portals in this 'Crane Simulator'
    > Added EASY MODE for friendship with the ZeLeLi
 
[b]- Added Steam Achievment support[/b]
    > Get Achievement for unlocking a new Sector
    > Get Achievement for perfectly clearing a Sector
    > Added Steam Trading Cards & Badges
   
[b]- Reworked complete "Slow CPU" Quality Mode for better gameplay on old PCs[/b]
    > Reduced Texture Quality
    > Reduces Light Sources
    > Reduces Particles
    > Removes Motion Blur
    > Removes Bloom Glowing
    > Removes Objects with high poly count
    > Removes not neccesary Background objects
    > Removes most of decoration objects

[h1][b]Enjoy![/b][/h1]

[b]Thanks you very much to everybody.[/b]
[h1]BplusGames & OtakuMaker.com Studio[/h1]

[h1][b]Puzzle Box Available on Steam Apr 22, 2016 for $ 8.99 is 10% OFF Now![/b][/h1]

[b]Puzzle Box is painting with creative gameplay! Create fantastic pixel art images, by dropping your colour paint blocks in the correct place across the levels.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/448720/

[h1][b]Could you put a "Add to your wishlist" & "Follow" Please[/b][/h1]

[b]Puzzle Box is the famous design suite from puzzle Box Setup on Nintendo 3DS[/b]

[b]Modes for Creation:[/b]
-Classic Mode with scrolling
-Copycat Mode for still images
 
[b]Modes to play in the arts:[/b]

-Boom Mode
Destroy your own made pixel art with a limited amount of bombs
 
-Run Mode
Run and Jump with Marshmallow Boy Roy on the top of your pixel art level and collect all the Combo Coins
 
-Kubi Mode
Pixel Hero Kubi has to collect all the colorful Pixel Flies and to feed his little dog within the Pixel Art, but be careful, evil shadow man are all around you
 
-Claw Mode
Control a flying Plattchen with a chain and a claw to kidnap all the Combo Coins in the polished Art environment. Avoid touching obstacles and watch the time.
 
Enjoy collecting all the Combo Coins and clear all 180 levels.

[b]We will keep you informed of the evolution of the game and its Improvements.[/b]

[b]Please visit the store page for more info.
Thank you for all of your support.[/b]
